children: nVent announced a $1.75 billion agreement to acquire Maverick Power, with up to $550 million additional contingent consideration.
Entered purchase agreement to buy Maverick Power for $1.75B plus up to $550M based on 2027–2028 performance.
Maverick Power: data‑center power distributor, ~900 employees, ~$527M revenue for 12 months ended June 30, 2026.
Deal expected to close Q4 2026, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals; termination rights extend to Feb 19, 2027.
Financing planned via net offering proceeds, $600M term loan, $250M specified revolver, and up to $1.5B bridge facility if needed.
Transaction will materially increase leverage (~$1.65B new indebtedness), posing integration, liability and liquidity risks.
